name: Julius Caesar
title: Dictator of Rome

ability.name: Crossing the Rubicon
ability.description: Declaring war gives your units +5 strength for 10 turns. Each settlement you capture gives 50 gold per citizen.

agenda.name: Imperator
agenda.description: Respects big armies. Dislikes smaller empires that turn down his deals.

quotes.greeting: You stand before Rome. Speak plainly, and Rome will listen.
quotes.war: The die is cast. My legions march on you.
quotes.peace: Let the gates of war close. Rome is generous to those who yield.
quotes.defeat: Even Rome falls. Remember that it stood.

intro: Gaius Julius Caesar: general, consul and master of Rome. Your legions built roads to every corner of the known world, and every road led home. Raise a city of marble, and make the empire eternal.

name: Cleopatra
title: Pharaoh of the Two Lands

ability.name: Serpent of the Nile
ability.description: Each deal you sign gives +1 influence a turn while it lasts. Trade routes to other players give +2 gold to both sides.

agenda.name: Allure
agenda.description: Likes strong militaries. Dislikes weak ones.

quotes.greeting: The Nile has carried your name to my court. Let us see if it was worth carrying.
quotes.war: You mistook my patience for weakness. Egypt will correct you.
quotes.peace: A wise ruler knows when a friend is worth more than a war.
quotes.defeat: The river will remember me, even if you do not.

intro: Cleopatra, last pharaoh of the Two Lands, whose wit outmatched the empires that circled her. The Nile floods, and Egypt grows rich. Build wonders on its banks that will outlast the stars.

name: Alexander the Great
title: King of Macedon

ability.name: Never Defeated
ability.description: Your war support never fades. Capturing a settlement fully heals all your units.

agenda.name: Conqueror
agenda.description: Dislikes players who are at peace with everyone.

quotes.greeting: I have marched farther than any man alive. Your lands are only the next horizon.
quotes.war: Why wait for the world to come to me? I will take yours.
quotes.peace: Very well. My army needs rest, and you have earned a little.
quotes.defeat: I conquered the world once. Someone had to end the march.

intro: Alexander of Macedon, who never lost a battle and never stopped marching. Your companions ride at your side and your phalanx holds the line. Carry your banner to the ends of the earth.

name: Genghis Khan
title: Great Khan of the Mongols

ability.name: Khan of the Steppe
ability.description: Cavalry +3 strength. Defeating an enemy cavalry unit can capture it.

agenda.name: Horde
agenda.description: Respects mounted armies. Dislikes players with few cavalry.

quotes.greeting: The steppe is wide, and my riders have seen its every edge. Who are you?
quotes.war: Your walls will not save you. Nothing has.
quotes.peace: Pay what you owe and live. The khan is satisfied.
quotes.defeat: The wind still blows across the steppe. It will carry my riders again.

intro: Temüjin, who united the clans of the steppe and became the Great Khan. Your riders move faster than any messenger and strike harder than any army. Ride, and let the world learn your name.

name: Elizabeth I
title: Queen of England

ability.name: Gloriana
ability.description: +100% great admiral points. Naval units +1 movement. +1 trade route in each era after the Medieval.

agenda.name: Queen of the Seas
agenda.description: Likes players with big navies who stay off her continent.

quotes.greeting: England greets you. I trust you have come with something worth my time.
quotes.war: I have the heart of a ruler and a fleet to match. You will meet both.
quotes.peace: England has no quarrel with those who keep their word.
quotes.defeat: Let it be written that the queen did not bow.

intro: Elizabeth, the queen who would not marry and would not yield. Your sea dogs rule the waves and your playwrights fill the theaters. Make this island the center of the world.

name: Napoleon Bonaparte
title: Emperor of the French

ability.name: Emperor of the French
ability.description: Commanders gain XP 50% faster. Units within a commander's radius get +2 strength.

agenda.name: Grand Strategist
agenda.description: Respects players with commanders and big armies. Dislikes players who beat him in war.

quotes.greeting: France salutes you. Let us see whether you are a friend, or merely an obstacle.
quotes.war: My marshals are bored. You will give them something to do.
quotes.peace: Glory can wait. France will take its gains in peace.
quotes.defeat: History will judge me kindly. I intend to write it.

intro: Napoleon Bonaparte, the artillery officer who crowned himself emperor. Your grand army marches on new roads under new laws. Remake the world in the image of France.

name: Abraham Lincoln
title: President of the United States

ability.name: A House United
ability.description: Settlements on your home continent +2 happiness. Each Industrial Zone grants a free melee unit.

agenda.name: Union
agenda.description: Dislikes players who start surprise wars. Likes players who keep their promises.

quotes.greeting: Welcome, friend. The American people hope we can do business as neighbors.
quotes.war: We did not seek this fight. But we will finish it.
quotes.peace: Let us bind up these wounds and build something better together.
quotes.defeat: A government of the people does not die with one city.

intro: Abraham Lincoln, the rail-splitter who held a divided nation together. Your people build, settle and invent on a continent of endless promise. Lead them toward a more perfect union.

name: Qin Shi Huang
title: First Emperor of China

ability.name: The First Emperor
ability.description: The first military unit each city trains is free. +15% production toward Ancient and Classical wonders.

agenda.name: Wonder of the World
agenda.description: Likes players who build wonders. Envies anyone who beats him to one.

quotes.greeting: You stand in the presence of the First Emperor. Kneel, or explain why you do not.
quotes.war: All under heaven will be one. Your lands are no exception.
quotes.peace: Order is restored. You may keep your borders, for now.
quotes.defeat: My wall stands. My tomb waits. My name endures.

intro: Qin Shi Huang, who unified the warring states and named himself the First Emperor. Your workers raise walls across mountains and roads that bind the provinces. Build an empire for ten thousand generations.

name: Mansa Musa
title: Mansa of Mali

ability.name: Pilgrimage of Gold
ability.description: International trade routes give +1 gold for each desert tile the origin settlement owns. (Golden ages arrive later.)

agenda.name: Richest Man in History
agenda.description: Likes players with large trade networks. Dislikes poor ones.

quotes.greeting: Peace be with you. Mali has gold enough to share, and patience enough to listen.
quotes.war: Gold buys many things. Today it buys an army.
quotes.peace: Trade is better than war. Let the caravans move again.
quotes.defeat: The salt roads will remember who walked them first.

intro: Mansa Musa, whose pilgrimage scattered so much gold that prices fell in every city he passed. Your caravans cross the desert and your scholars fill Timbuktu. Make Mali the richest empire the world has seen.

name: Oda Nobunaga
title: Lord of Owari

ability.name: The Demon King
ability.description: Melee units +5 strength when attacking a damaged unit. Gunpowder units cost 25% less and get +3 strength.

agenda.name: Unifier
agenda.description: Respects players who take settlements. Dislikes players with weak armies.

quotes.greeting: I have no time for ceremony. State your business.
quotes.war: Life is short. I will not spend mine waiting for you to strike first.
quotes.peace: Very well. The sword returns to its sheath, for now.
quotes.defeat: Fifty years under heaven pass like a dream. So be it.

intro: Oda Nobunaga, the warlord who set out to unify a land at war with itself. Your samurai are disciplined and your guns are many. Bring all of Japan under one rule.
